arguments.cmd:
# SOURCE-READY PROPOSAL ONLY: root acceptance and a fresh grant are required.
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
P213_B_OUT='/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p213_b_initial_run01'
P213_B_KEYS='/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/qa/p213_b_execution_preparation01/EXTERNAL_KEYS.cjs'
P213_B_VERIFY='/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics/docs/papers211_215_sequence/reviews/p213_b/verify.py'
cd -- /root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 700 -- "$P213_B_OUT"
set -C
exec 3>&1 4>&2
exec > "$P213_B_OUT/controller.stdout" 2> "$P213_B_OUT/controller.stderr"
p213_b_finish() {
  local p213_b_rc=$?
  trap - EXIT
  printf '%s\n' "$p213_b_rc" > "$P213_B_OUT/controller.exit"
  printf 'P213_B_CAPTURE_EXIT=%s\n' "$p213_b_rc" >&3
  exit "$p213_b_rc"
}
trap p213_b_finish EXIT
/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/node "$P213_B_KEYS" inputs < /dev/null > "$P213_B_OUT/keys.before.json" 2> "$P213_B_OUT/keys.before.stderr"
set +e
/usr/bin/env -i LANG=C LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/python3.10 -I -S -B "$P213_B_VERIFY" < /dev/null 3>&- 4>&- > "$P213_B_OUT/stdout.bin" 2> "$P213_B_OUT/stderr.bin"
P213_B_PYTHON_STATUS=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$P213_B_PYTHON_STATUS" > "$P213_B_OUT/python.exit"
/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/node "$P213_B_KEYS" inputs < /dev/null > "$P213_B_OUT/keys.after.json" 2> "$P213_B_OUT/keys.after.stderr"
/usr/bin/cmp -- "$P213_B_OUT/keys.before.json" "$P213_B_OUT/keys.after.json" > "$P213_B_OUT/input-key-cmp.stdout" 2> "$P213_B_OUT/input-key-cmp.stderr"
/usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C LC_ALL=C /usr/bin/node "$P213_B_KEYS" outputs initial < /dev/null > "$P213_B_OUT/raw.keys.json" 2> "$P213_B_OUT/raw.keys.stderr"
[[ "$P213_B_PYTHON_STATUS" == 0 ]] || exit "$P213_B_PYTHON_STATUS"
[[ -s "$P213_B_OUT/stdout.bin" ]]
[[ ! -s "$P213_B_OUT/stderr.bin" ]]

proposed_continuation.rule: Only the actual session returned by this newly granted request, receiving to completion; no retry, second submission, kill or fabricated final status.

output_schema.name: P213_B_OCCUPATION_RELATION_LAYERS_V1
output_schema.order: n, then N, lexicographic STATE; all binary-word CHAMBER records by increasing bit-code for n>=3; CARRIER follows each carrier; final PASS

bootstrap_boundary: Ordinary trusted tool control, Bash/env/mkdir/cmp/Node/fs/crypto/Python/builtins, fixed namespace ancestors and storage. External fixed keys are not own-process module/map/fd/runtime observation. Historical baseline keys are provenance only; current keys must be freshly captured before/after this invocation.
capture_limit_kind: Success/reception bounds after complete direct-to-file capture, not OS-enforced stdout/time/memory/storage limits; over-bound/partial/failing originals are preserved.

canonical.role: Root-selected line-oriented exact raw ASCII LF stdout adapter, accepted in qa/p213_b_source_root01/RECEPTION.md; no JSON parsing, normalization or synthetic expected data.
canonical.source: only complete accepted actual B initial stdout.bin; never author or A output/canonical or synthetic reconstruction

failure_policy: Preserve actual failure/status and partial artifacts, HOLD; no automatic retry, directory reuse, source/box change or output normalization.
